# Bundled font notices

The static TTF files under `public/fonts/generated` retain the following
copyright and version metadata:

- Inter 4.001 (`git-66647c0bb`): Copyright 2016 The Inter Project Authors
  (<https://github.com/rsms/inter>).
- DM Sans 4.004 (`gftools[0.9.30]`): Copyright 2014 The DM Sans Project
  Authors (<https://github.com/googlefonts/dm-fonts>).
- Fira Code 6.002: Copyright 2014-2021 The Fira Code Project Authors
  (<https://github.com/tonsky/FiraCode>).
- JetBrains Mono 2.211: Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors
  (<https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono>).

Each family is licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1. The full
license is in [OFL-1.1.txt](OFL-1.1.txt).

The exact commits from which these binaries were downloaded, and the command
used to create their static instances, are not retained in Nanquim's history.
Their version and license statements above were read from the binaries'
embedded name tables. Preserve this limitation until the files are replaced by
a reproducible, checksum-pinned font update.
